topic: The match secretly fixed to help the opposing team win
hook: They deliberately lost — to help their opponents win.
script: They deliberately lost — to help their opponents win. In 2010, the spot-fixing scandal shook cricket. Players bowled deliberate no-balls on signal for betting syndicates. Real money. Real corruption. Three Pakistan players were jailed. The game was shattered. Trust took years to rebuild. Follow for cricket scandals that changed the sport forever.
